content.title: Timothée Chalamet, Kylie Jenner Have Supreme Date Night at Oscars 2026
content.text: They're just mad you left out jazz.Timothée Chalamet Reacts to Conan O'Brien's Dig at His Ballet, Opera Comments at Oscars 20260 seconds of 1 minute, 54 secondsVolume 0%Timothée Chalamet Reacts to Conan O'Brien's Dig at His Ballet, Opera Comments at Oscars 2026Can you keep up with Timothée Chalamet and Kylie Jenner’s last date night of this award season? Over the last few months, the couple of three years have left jaws on the floor with their glam outings. And the 2026 Oscars were no different. In fact, Kylie made a rare red carpet outing with Timothée, arriving at the Dolby Theatre in Los Angeles for the March 15 ceremony in a full-length red Schiaparelli gown. Meanwhile, the Marty Supreme star donned an all-white suit. (See all the stars on the red carpet here.) If Kylie at the Oscars is starting to sound familiar, it’s because she joined Timothée, 30, at the 2025 ceremony—though she swapped places with his mom Nicole Flender when his Best Lead Actor category was announced. And though the Complete Unknown actor didn’t walk away with the statuette last year—Adrien Brody won his second Oscar that night—he is once again nominated at the 98th Academy Awards for his role in the ping pong film.Joining him in the category are One Battle After Another’s Leonardo DiCaprio, Blue Moon’s Ethan Hawke, Sinners’ Michael B. Jordan and The Secret Agent’s Wagner Moura. And it’s been a busy season for this group, who have been grouped together in many of the same categories throughout award season.John Shearer/98th Oscars/Getty Images The Academy via Getty ImagesAnother constant this award season? Kylie as Timothée’s plus one—barring the Actor Awards where his mom joined him—as she’s joined him on several of the season’s most start-studded nights. This includes cheering him on as he took home a Critics Choice Award and a Golden Globe. And on each of those occasions, he couldn’t help but give her a special nod. “Lastly, I'll just say thank you to my partner of three years,” Timothée shared as he closed out his speech at the Critics Choice Awards on Jan. 4. “Thank you for our foundation. I love you. I couldn't do this without you. Thank you from the bottom of my heart.” As for Kylie, the visibly moved Kardashians star simply mouthed back, “I love you.” Of course, they’re not the only duo heating up the Dolby Theatre.
